(a) Raw-vs-rule reach: none -- all three residuals decode 100% REGFIELD-ONLY and all three rules are register-field stages, so the class reaches the residual in every case. (b) Replay: none -- three BYTE-EQUAL. (c) Postprocessed object: none -- three EXACT / real 0. (d) Image: doldiff exit 0. (e) PROVENANCE -- AND THIS ONE FAILED, on a dimension round 1 did not screen. sndVoiceUpdateAll's entry carries BOTH an empty `mechanism` AND no `audit` block, so the rule file records neither a derivation nor a machine classification for it; its class is `recolors`, an explicit register-field edit list. Corpus census over all 158 entries: mechanism EMPTY 35; mechanism present but citing NO record id 23; audit block ABSENT 5; BOTH empty mechanism AND no audit block 1, and that one is sndVoiceUpdateAll. So the drawn row is the singleton worst case in the file, and the 3-of-156 draw found it -- which is the control working, not luck being bad. The credit is still sound on bytes (the replay and the object comparison are what decide that); what is missing is the AUDIT TRAIL, and that is a separate, real defect against the Mandatory-result-policy source-exhaustion bar.

hypothesis.cheapest_refuting_observation: One command per row, zero builds: `python memory_graph/gdlmem.py context <fn>` on each zero-mechanism entry's function. A row whose context returns an accepted parked/capped attempt is a CITATION defect (cheap); a row whose context is empty is a PROVENANCE defect (expensive, and the rule should not have shipped). Measured here on the one row drawn: sndVoiceUpdateAll returns exactly one accepted attempt, outcome `parked` -- a citation defect, not a provenance hole.
